summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Corporate Actions Processing System. All backend APIs working correctly, frontend UI fully functional with proper integration. System successfully handles event management, entitlements processing, positions tracking, and audit logging.
passed_tests: GET /api/ returns system message correctly
GET /api/dashboard returns metrics, deadlines, type_breakdown, pipeline with correct structure
GET /api/events returns paginated events (15 total, 10 per page) with proper structure
GET /api/events with search parameter filters correctly (Apple search works)
GET /api/events with type filter returns only matching events (Dividend filter works)
POST /api/events creates new event with Announced status and adds audit entry
GET /api/events/{id} retrieves specific event correctly
PUT /api/events/{id}/process advances event status through pipeline (Announced → Validated)
GET /api/entitlements returns entitlements with correct structure (7 total)
GET /api/entitlements with filter_type=pending returns filtered results
PUT /api/entitlements/{id}/elect submits election choice and updates status to Elected
POST /api/entitlements/submit-all processes bulk elections (2 elections submitted)
GET /api/positions returns positions with metrics (10 positions, 6 accounts)
GET /api/audit returns audit timeline entries (16+ entries with correct structure)
Dashboard tab displays 5 metric cards with correct values (7 pending, 4 processed, 2 elections due)
Dashboard shows upcoming deadlines table, event type breakdown chart, processing pipeline
Event Queue tab has search input, type/status filters, paginated table with View/Process buttons
New Event modal opens with all form fields and creates events successfully
Event search functionality works (Apple search returns 1 result)
Event processing buttons advance status and update audit log
Event detail modal opens and displays event information correctly
Entitlements tab has filter buttons (All, Pending election, Elected, Mandatory)
Voluntary entitlements show election option buttons that work correctly
Submit All Elections button processes bulk submissions
Positions tab shows 4 metric cards and positions table with risk/payment type badges
Audit Log tab shows color-coded timeline entries with timestamps
Tab navigation switches between all 5 views correctly
Pagination works correctly (Next/Previous buttons functional)
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
